placements.why: The content describes an end-to-end test reproducing a production failure pattern and prescribing required outcomes — verification content that warrants its own organizational category since nothing existing covers it.
placements.title: Verification through reproduced failure
placements.frame: What must a test verify about system behavior under failure conditions?

placements.title: From production crash to reproduced test requirement
placements.frame: How does reproducing a production failure pattern in an end-to-end test establish what the system must guarantee?
placements.why: Both expressions address the same E2E test for the missing-id failure pattern: src-1 reproduces the production failure (a ## heading with no id field), src-2 prescribes the required outcomes (no crash, valid slug). Together they form a theme about using E2E tests to verify crash prevention and valid output against real failure patterns.
